technique_name: Formulate a strategy for a client company that is looking to improve their website's SEO.
description: I suggest that the client's website should focus on improving their SEO by optimizing the content of the webpage to include relevant keywords, as well as improving their internal linking structure. Additionally they should focus on improving their back-linking strategies, involving creating engaging social media content and reaching out to other sites that could link to their page.
